cohort: 88 parturients, ASA class II, aged 20-30 years, undergoing spinal anaesthesia for caesarean section.
finding: Propofol and dexmedetomidine were found to be equally effective in decreasing intraoperative nausea and vomiting during spinal anaesthesia for caesarean section, though bradycardia was significantly higher in the dexmedetomidine group and hypotension was significantly higher in the propofol group.
mod_finding: The study found that propofol and dexmedetomidine are equally effective in decreasing intraoperative nausea and vomiting during spinal anaesthesia specifically for caesarean section.
